# Fresh-board readiness evidence

Two unchanged native1920×1080 PNGs from protected2.9.128 PID557656.
`dealing.png` is the failed first post-handoff observation: Nines7/15,
slot26 (fixed7|6) is displaced and has no recognisable glyph at its usual origin.
`settled.png` is the later successful Single board scan's initial position.
All28 identities and the same starting piles are recognised by unchanged native-v22.

These are exposed regressions, not holdout calibration. They add no glyph samples,
threshold changes or profile variants. Repeated/interleaved fixture sequences
are synthetic tests of bounded readiness, equality and cancellation; the two
stills do not measure an animation duration or prove guest input effects.
Exact originals, hashes and source paths are in [provenance.json](provenance.json).

`dealing-later.png` is the second native128 refusal (m12901), Nines13/15,
with partial moving-card ink at slot26. Its exact original and packet hashes
are retained in the validation workroot's evidence-supplement.json. It is also
an exposed readiness regression, with no calibration additions.
